build_DeticCascadeROIHeads: build a DeticCascadeROIHeads model with mult proposal score, image labels, and one class per proposal options
create_from_config: create DeticCascadeROIHeads from a Detectron2 config with cascade box head and zero-shot classifier settings
run_forward_box: run the forward box pass through cascade stages with optional image label and caption annotation types
test_init_box_head: test the init box head method to create DeticFastRCNNOutputLayers predictors for each cascade stage
review_get_top_proposals: review the get top proposals method that clips boxes, limits count, and optionally adds an image box
run_forward: run the full ROI head forward pass supporting box, image, caption, and proptag annotation types
test_create_proposals_from_boxes: test the create proposals from boxes method to build Instances with detached boxes and objectness logits
review_run_stage: review the run stage method that pools box features, scales gradients, and runs the stage predictor
